label: def:embeddable-knot-operator
title: Embeddable knot operator with geometric overlap weight
html:
An embeddable knot operator is a knot operator K together with an embedding of its braid into the ambient 3-manifold, carrying an overlap weight w \in (0, 1] determined by the embedding direction relative to the bond axis. Its binding contribution is

  \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}}(K) = \mathfrak{E}_0(K)\, w ,

where \mathfrak{E}_0(K) is the un-embedded channel binding. The operator is axial (\sigma-type) if its braid runs along the bond axis, in which case w = 1, and transverse (\pi-type) if its braid lies in the plane transverse to the bond axis, in which case w = w_\perp < 1, the transverse/axial overlap ratio fixed per system. The binding of a composite is the overlap-weighted sum

  \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{bind}}\Bigl(\textstyle\bigcup_i K_i\Bigr) = \sum_i \mathfrak{E}_0(K_i)\, w_i .
